text:
Evan Brooks: OpalTek sent an RFI asking for a one-page capability matrix, short written answers about BYOK/HSM, VPC peering, EU/UK data residency options, and a POC quote with line items. Uploaded doc: s3://redwood-sales/opaltek/opaltek-rfi-2026.pdf. They asked for delivery within 48 hours.

Rina Patel: Proposed POC: 3 business days: Day 0 prep & identity mapping, Day 1 ingest + embeddings eval, Day 2 perf + handover. Include replay script and small eval dataset. Will build capability matrix with limitations column.

Omar Khaled: Quick numbers from OpalTek: peak conc. sessions ~110, embeddings ~6k/day, EU-only storage mandate. Also asked if we permit HSM key export and whether we support customer-managed HSMs in Private.

Sophie (legal): NDA + DPA required before any customer data ingestion. Recommend SOW that caps POC retention to 21 days, includes deletion verification steps and accepts a scoped pen-test plan. I'll prepare templates.

Rina Patel: For capability matrix columns: Feature | Hosted API | Dedicated (reserved) | Private (VPC/on-prem) | Notes/Limitations. Rows: tenant isolation, per-tenant KMS, HSM import, key export policy, VPC peering, regional residency, SLA, audit logs.

Omar Khaled: Security answers: we support BYOK into customer-managed HSMs (PKCS#11/CloudHSM). We do NOT allow private-key export from customer HSMs. Private deployments can be deployed to EU regions or on-prem for strict residency. Hosted customers can request regional-only tenancy under enterprise contract; we should mark it as "available by request".

Evan Brooks: Pricing idea: $3,000 platform credits + $1,000 infra stipend (if on-prem kit needed). Optional temp Dedicated pool for POC: priced as a 2-week reserved block; include as optional line item. Conversion path: if customer signs Dedicated commit within 45 days, provide 25% credit applied to first invoice. Finance to confirm.

Rina Patel: Need to confirm Dedicated baseline SLO wording. I suggest we state: Dedicated pools target 99.95% uptime SLA (model-dependent), with autoscale options and configurable latency targets per model. Mark exact latencies as model-specific.

CI Bot: Reminder: attach final RFI deliverables to customer workspace when ready.

Omar Khaled: Pen-test note: we require a scoped test plan and 10 business days notice for full penetration tests. For light scanning we can provide a shorter window but still need to review test vectors.

Rina Patel: Small deliverable: will include an example embeddings eval curl in the deliverable and a tiny harness in GH. Example: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["policy paragraph","kb note"]}'

Sophie (legal): I'll upload NDA+DPA templates and a short SOW snippet that limits retention and outlines deletion verification. Also will add language about pen-test scheduling and escalation contacts.

Evan Brooks: I'll assemble the capability_matrix_opaltek_v1.xlsx, rfi_answers_opaltek_v1.md, and the POC quote (line items: credits, infra stipend, optional temp Dedicated) and upload to s3://redwood-sales/opaltek/deliverables/ this afternoon.

Rina Patel: Drafting written answers now. I'll call out: per-tenant key rotation, audit trails, support for AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault integrations for Hosted Enterprise, and HSM import for Private. Will flag FedRAMP as roadmap and offer SOC2 + isolated Dedicated tenancy as compensating controls.

Omar Khaled: Tech note for matrix: prefix caching and KV-cache reuse can reduce token cost ~15-25% for chat workloads; include that in Notes. Also mention that Private supports VPC peering and direct network ingress for low-latency setups.

Evan Brooks: If no legal/finance blockers I'll return the RFI package to OpalTek by EOD. :thumbsup:

Sophie (legal): Reviewed. No blockers from legal on templates. Finance sign-off pending for credits/stipend but likely approved. Send when ready. :white_check_mark:
